items.program_name: 雇用創出税額控除(OH JCTC)
items.summary: Ohio Tax Credit Authorityが、Blue Ash市の4myBenefits, Inc.のプロジェクトに対し、雇用創出税額控除(JCTC)として7年間1.240%の税額控除を承認。新規雇用50人・年間給与$3.0Mの創出を約束。
items.verbatim: Ohio Tax Credit Authority approved a tax exemption (Data Center Sales Tax Exemption or JCTC-type exemption) of 1.240% for 7 years on 2024-06-24 for a project in the City of Blue Ash, Hamilton County. Commitment: create 50 full-time equivalent employees generating $3,000,000 in new annual payroll at
